description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): split an integer amount of cents by integer ratios with the largest-remainder rule from a stub and an instructions file - ties to the earlier index, negative amounts mirror the positive result, no negative zero, exactness near the safe integer limit (needs BigInt or equivalent), and validation of amount and ratios. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
